files.summary: recognize delivered owner-private character notes without implying private messaging or hosted acceptance
edits: Owner-scoped character-note reading/editing and denial of another human’s private mind are already implemented through the shared authority boundary, with scoped authenticated-browser and native evidence under [MP01](maintainers/multiplayer.md#priority-2-implementation-slices). This does not imply a separate private player-to-player messaging channel or complete hosted security qualification.
